title: What Is Context Engineering? Why AI Agents Need It
description:
What Is Context Engineering? Why AI Agents Need It
Context engineering gives AI agents the right information at the right time, helping them make more accurate and reliable decisions.
In this 47-second AI tutorial, you’ll learn what context engineering is, how it differs from prompt engineering, and why prompts alone aren’t enough for dependable AI agents.
Discover how instructions, conversation history, memory, RAG documents, API results, available tools, and task state shape an AI agent’s decisions. You’ll also see why more context isn’t always better—and how irrelevant or outdated information can reduce reliability.
Effective context engineering retrieves, filters, structures, and compresses information so an AI agent receives only what matters for its next decision.
